name: Detect security drift in n8n workflows and email new findings with SMTP

parameters.content:
## Detect security drift in n8n workflows and email new findings
Weekly read-only audit of all workflows on your instance. You get an email with only the findings that are new since the last run.

### How it works
1. Loads all workflows through the n8n API. Archived ones are skipped.
2. Checks for hardcoded secrets (also in inactive workflows), webhooks without authentication, active test or temp workflows, missing or broken error workflows, lowered execution-data protection, MCP access switched back on, webhook auth headers stored in the log, dead branches and ignored nested parameters.
3. Compares the result with the last run and emails the new findings.
4. Writes the baseline only after the email went out, so nothing gets lost if sending fails.

### Setup
1. Create an n8n API key (Settings > n8n API) and add it as an n8n API credential in *Fetch All Workflows*.
2. Add an SMTP credential to *Dispatch Alert Email*.
3. Fill in notifyTo and notifyFrom in *Set Configuration Values*.
4. Set your error workflow in the workflow settings.
5. Run once manually, then activate.

n8n saves the baseline (static data) only in production runs. The first scheduled run reports everything once.

### Customization
- acceptedKeys: paste a finding key from the email to accept it on purpose.
- testNamePattern: regex for names of test or temp workflows.
- Change the schedule in *Weekly Monday Trigger*.

## Trigger and configuration

Starts the workflow either on the Monday schedule or manually, then centralizes notification and security-check configuration values used downstream.

## Load and scan workflows

Fetches all workflows from the n8n instance and runs the baseline security drift checks across them.

## Compare and branch

Compares current security findings with the previous run and branches based on whether there are new findings to report.

## Notify and persist

Sends an alert email when new findings are detected, then writes the updated baseline as the final action of the run.
